reason: Control: the base Patient has no required clinical fields.
Control: a synthetic AU Core Patient with the required identifier, name, gender and birth date.
R4 JSON: boolean primitives use JSON booleans, not strings.
R4 JSON: date primitives use JSON strings.
R4 JSON: a Reference is an object, not a primitive string.
Patient has no surpriseField element.
R4 JSON: repeating elements are arrays even when they contain one item.
R4 JSON: a single-valued element is not an array.
FHIR date must have a supported calendar-date lexical form.
2023 is not a leap year; February 29 is not a calendar date.
FHIR date permits year-only precision.
R4 JSON: empty arrays are not permitted; this also removes the required name.
R4 JSON: primitive strings cannot be empty.
FHIR integer is a signed 32-bit integer.
FHIR integer does not permit a fractional value.
Control: one permitted deceased[x] choice.
Patient.deceased[x] has maximum cardinality one across its choices.
The resourceType must identify a known FHIR resource.
HL7 validator 6.10.4 with -tx n/a reports the unresolvable declared profile as a warning, not an error; verdict remains valid.
Extension.url has minimum cardinality one.
Extension invariant ext-1 forbids both nested extensions and a value.
DomainResource invariant dom-2 forbids nested contained resources.
Offline reference-target control: reference type enforcement must be measured, not assumed.
R4 JSON permits a primitive with only its underscore extension carrier.
R4 JSON null is reserved for positional placeholders in primitive arrays.
R4 JSON permits null placeholders in aligned primitive value/extension arrays.
Control: Condition.clinicalStatus supplies a code from its required value set.
A required-bound CodeableConcept still needs a coding when it carries only data-absent-reason.
Text alone does not satisfy a required CodeableConcept binding.
A Coding without code content does not satisfy its parent CodeableConcept's required binding.
The parent CodeableConcept's required binding still applies when the resource declares a compiled profile.
Control: Encounter.class supplies a code from its required value set.
validator_cli 6.10.4 accepts a standalone required-bound Coding with system but no code; this controls the narrower CodeableConcept rule.
Control: a nested Composition section under a declared profile carries a valid base list-mode code.
Base required bindings still apply below contentReference recursion when a compiled profile is declared.
A de-identified age over 89 as the spec's own aggregate: an Age with comparator '>=' and value 90 is valid. This is what the collapse-age policy rule writes on an Age, Duration, Count or Distance.

The comparator form is valid on a plain Quantity (Observation.valueQuantity): only the elements the base types SimpleQuantity refuse one, which the shape walk applies by element (typemap ELEMENT_PROFILES). The collapse-age rule still writes the bare value on every Quantity.
Observation.referenceRange.low is a SimpleQuantity in R4 (type.profile): a comparator there is refused (comparator max 0, sqty-1).
Control: the same SimpleQuantity elements without a comparator are valid, and the plain Quantity value beside them may carry one.
A comparator present only through its extension carrier (`_comparator`) is still the element: max 0 and sqty-1 both refuse it, beside the required binding's missing code.
Dosage.doseAndRate.dose[x]'s Quantity alternative is a SimpleQuantity (a datatype's element, reached through MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction).
MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.quantity is a SimpleQuantity: a comparator is refused.
Control: dose and dispense quantities without a comparator are valid.
Specimen.collection.quantity is a SimpleQuantity: a comparator is refused.
NutritionOrder.enteralFormula.maxVolumeToDeliver is a SimpleQuantity: a comparator is refused.
Immunization.doseQuantity is a SimpleQuantity: a comparator is refused.
MedicationAdministration.dosage.rate[x]'s Quantity alternative (rateQuantity) is a SimpleQuantity: a comparator is refused.
Range.low is a SimpleQuantity wherever a Range sits (here Observation.valueRange): a comparator is refused.
SampledData.origin is a SimpleQuantity: a comparator is refused.
MedicationKnowledge.kinetics.areaUnderCurve repeats and is a SimpleQuantity: a comparator on the second item is refused there.
A SimpleQuantity inside a contained resource (Observation.referenceRange.high): a comparator is refused.
A SimpleQuantity inside a Bundle entry's resource: a comparator is refused.
Under a declared compiled profile (base body weight): the base's SimpleQuantity on referenceRange.low still refuses a comparator.

An extension profile (hl7.fhir.uv.extensions.r4 medicationdispense-quantityRemaining) types its value[x] Quantity with SimpleQuantity, where the base Extension.value[x] names no profile: a comparator on valueQuantity is refused there (max 0, sqty-1).
Control: the same extension value without a comparator is valid.
Control: NZ Base types Patient.address NzAddress alone, whose suburb extension slice is max 1; one suburb conforms.

The IG's own datatype profile on an unsliced element is applied: two suburb extensions break NzAddress's max 1 (validator_cli 6.10.4: 'Address.extension:suburb: max allowed = 1, but found 2 (from …/NzAddress|1.0.0)' at Patient.address[0]).
Control: NZ Base types Patient.telecom NzContactpoint alone, whose cp-purpose extension slice is max 1; one purpose conforms.
Two cp-purpose extensions break NzContactpoint's max 1 (validator_cli 6.10.4: 'ContactPoint.extension:cp-purpose: max allowed = 1, but found 2 (from …/NzContactpoint|1.0.0)' at Patient.telecom[0]).
Control: CA Baseline types Patient.identifier profile-identifier alone (system and value 1..1); this identifier carries both.
An identifier without a system breaks profile-identifier, applied on the unsliced element; validator_cli 6.10.4 reports it from both the datatype profile and the Patient profile's own snapshot.

AU Core types Patient.address 'au-address' or base 'Address': conformance to either is enough, so an address breaking every au-address rule (no line or text, a five-digit postcode, country NZ) is valid on both sides.

AU Core's unsliced Patient.identifier lists base Identifier beside the AU identifier profiles: a medical record number missing the system and assigner au-medicalrecordnumber requires is still a valid Identifier.
AU Base DiagnosticReport.identifier (unsliced) lists base Identifier beside the local order / report / accession profiles: an identifier missing the system they require is valid.
An AU identifier profile reached through a slice is applied: an IHI failing the Luhn check breaks au-ihi's inv-ihi-value-2 (validator_cli 6.10.4, at Patient.identifier[1]).
NzAddress applies to each address: of three, the second's two suburbs break max 1 (validator_cli 6.10.4, at Patient.address[1]; the pod names the same address).
A telecom with a value and no system is cpt-2, reported once (validator_cli 6.10.4, at Patient.telecom[0]): NzContactpoint applies only what it adds over ContactPoint, not the base invariant again.
A suburb extension valued with a code where it allows a string is one error (validator_cli 6.10.4, at Patient.address[0].extension[0]): the extension is held to its profile once, by the shape walk.
cpt-2 and NzContactpoint's cp-purpose max 1, each once (validator_cli 6.10.4, both at Patient.telecom[0]).
CA Baseline holds Practitioner.identifier to profile-identifier alone: an identifier without a system is one error from it (validator_cli 6.10.4, at Practitioner.identifier[0]).

An extension's CodeableConcept value outside its required set (questionnaireresponse-completionMode): validator_cli 6.10.4 locates it at QuestionnaireResponse.extension[0].value.ofType(CodeableConcept), as the pod now does (was extension[0].Extension.value[x]).
A data-absent-reason valued with a string where it allows a code: validator_cli 6.10.4 locates it at the extension, Patient.name[0].extension[0], as the pod now does.
A data-absent-reason code outside its required set: validator_cli 6.10.4 locates it at Patient.name[0].extension[0].value.ofType(code), a primitive by its type code, as the pod now does.

A nested extension (patient-nationality code) valued with a string where its slice allows a CodeableConcept: validator_cli 6.10.4 locates it at the matched instance's value, Patient.extension[0].extension[1].value.ofType(string), as the pod now does (was extension[0].Extension.extension:code.value[x]).

A nested extension's CodeableConcept value (patient-sexParameterForClinicalUse value) outside its required set: validator_cli 6.10.4 locates it at Patient.extension[0].extension[0].value.ofType(CodeableConcept), as the pod now does.

An NzPatient that also declares NzAddress, with a suburb valued with a code: validator_cli 6.10.4 reports the suburb's type once, at Patient.address[0].extension[0], and refuses the NzAddress declaration on a Patient; the pod reports the suburb once (the declared NzAddress is not applied to a Patient, so it takes nothing from the shape walk) beside profile.wrong-type.

NzPatient slices Patient.extension:domicile-code; a domicile-code valued with a string on a contact's address (plain Address) is still held to its definition: validator_cli 6.10.4 refuses it at Patient.contact[0].address.extension[0]. The pod had skipped every instance of a url a declared slice named (valid); it now holds this one where it sits.

A domicile-code valued with a string on Patient.name[0] under NzPatient: validator_cli 6.10.4 reports the context and the type error at Patient.name[0].extension[0]; the pod had reported the context only.

A domicile-code valued with a string where NzPatient's own slice holds it (Patient.extension): one error, located by validator_cli 6.10.4 at the instance, Patient.extension[0], as the pod now locates it (was Patient.extension.value[x]).

A domicile-code valued with a string on Patient.address[0], held to NzAddress: one error at Patient.address[0].extension[0] (validator_cli 6.10.4), from the shape walk, as the pod now locates it (was Patient.address[0].extension.value[x]).

patient-citizenship with two period sub-extensions valued with strings: validator_cli 6.10.4 reports max 1 at Patient.extension[0] and one type error at each instance, Patient.extension[0].extension[0] and [1] (value.ofType(string)); the pod now reports each instance at its index (was one finding at the slice's label).
